common_inputs.account: The account's id or name, as list_accounts shows it. Required by every tool except list_accounts.
common_inputs.from: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Only used when `to` is also given; otherwise the last 30 days.
common_inputs.to: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Only used when `from` is also given; otherwise yesterday.

list_accounts.summary: Every ad account in the workspace, with its id and kind. Start here.

account_summary.summary: Spend, conversions, platform-claimed revenue, what the shop recorded, revenue the shop credits to ads, and unit economics (margin, breakeven, kept per order).

campaigns.summary: Every campaign on Google and Meta with spend, conversions, revenue, ROAS, POAS and, for Google search, impression share and share lost to rank. platform: all | google_ads | meta.

creatives.summary: Meta ads with spend, revenue, frequency, hook and hold rate, and a verdict (stop, fading, scale, iterate, keep, early), plus ad sets with conversions per week. Meta only.

monthly_profit.summary: Net profit before tax by month: revenue, gross profit, ad spend, fixed costs. Null ad spend means no ad data for that month.

proposals.summary: What the rule engine proposed, its state (waiting, approved, declined) and the rule behind each.

track_record.summary: Applied changes measured seven days later: forecast against outcome, tallied by rule.

reports.summary: Saved reports: blocks, period, schedule, recipients, client link, last sent.

creative_evidence.summary: Winning ads and the words they used, ads Meta stopped funding, the business, products that sold, measured margin, typical frequency, and what is not measured.

budget_plan.summary: Monthly budget and pacing (spent, 7-day daily rate, projected month end, daily amount to land on budget), each campaign's 14-day profit per euro, budget-capped campaigns and proposed moves.

creative_lab.summary: Creative lab concepts with tags, state and verdict (kill, keep, graduate, iterate), per-hook numbers, and the ledger of what each angle, desire, awareness stage and buyer has won or lost.

read_file.summary: Read one of the client's uploaded files in full, in slices.

search_files.summary: Find words across the client's uploaded files.
